title: Opinion frame
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y9 lesson 2 (Opinion frame (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 2: Giving opinions about subjects with reasons. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

model.title: Give an opinion about science with a reason.

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: In my opinion science is interesting because we learn about Allah's creation, but it is sometimes hard.

panels.title: Asking for opinions
points: مَا رَأْيُكَ فِي العُلُومِ؟: what do you think of science?
أَيُّ مَادَّةٍ تُفَضِّلُ؟: which subject do you prefer?

parts.text: Start with فِي رَأْيِي. Subject + adjective: الحَاسُوبُ مُفِيدٌ. Reason: لِأَنَّهُ مُهِمٌّ لِلْمُسْتَقْبَلِ.

questions.a: For example: فِي رَأْيِي الحَاسُوبُ مُفِيدٌ لِأَنَّهُ مُهِمٌّ لِلْمُسْتَقْبَلِ.
أُفَضِّلُ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ عَلَى اللُّغَةِ الإِنْجِلِيزِيَّةِ

questions.q: Ask a girl which subject she prefers.
Core: Write opinions on three subjects, each with a reason (portal response box). Starter: فِي رَأْيِي ...
questions.a: For example: فِي رَأْيِي الرِّيَاضِيَّاتُ مُهِمَّةٌ لِأَنَّهَا مُفِيدَةٌ فِي الحَيَاةِ. أُفَضِّلُ العُلُومَ عَلَى التَّارِيخِ لِأَنَّهَا مُمْتِعَةٌ. أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ الفَنَّ سَهْلٌ.

questions.q: Extend: In a breakout pair, ask each other مَا رَأْيُكَ فِي ...؟ about two subjects and note the answers.
questions.a: Two questions and two justified answers each

questions.q: Stretch: Write a balanced opinion: positive, negative and conclusion.
questions.a: For example: التَّارِيخُ مُمْتِعٌ، لٰكِنَّ فِيهِ تَوَارِيخَ كَثِيرَةً، وَمَعَ ذٰلِكَ أُحِبُّهُ.
A) أُفَضِّلُ التَّارِيخَ عَلَى الجُغْرَافِيَا. أُفَضِّلُ A عَلَى B = I prefer A to B.

questions.q: What does أُفَضِّلُ mean? A) I prefer B) I study C) I think
Big question: give and justify one opinion in Arabic.
questions.a: For example: فِي رَأْيِي العُلُومُ مُمْتِعَةٌ لِأَنَّنَا نَتَعَلَّمُ عَنِ الطَّبِيعَةِ.
